name: pm-assumption-mapping
description: Maps the beliefs behind a product idea as desirability, feasibility and viability assumptions, plots them by importance and evidence, and picks the riskiest three with a test type each. Use for "run pm-assumption-mapping", "assumption mapping", "what are we assuming", "riskiest assumption", "de-risk this idea", "what should we test first", "leap of faith assumptions", "we are about to build on a hunch", part of the AI for Product Management Pack by 90n.
